content.text: Write a file data/summary.csv with the header team,fte_total and one row per team giving that team's total FTE, taken from the headcount register.

arguments.command: grep -E 'team\s+"[^"]*"\s+"[0-9]*"' data/registration.txt | sed -e 's/.*team\s+"([^""]+)"\s+"([0-9]+)".*/\1,\2/' | head -n 3 | tail -n +2 > data/summary.csv
